subject: da-01: Full WCAG color contrast table -- exam.html light and dark mode
body:
## WCAG Color Contrast Audit: exam.html

Date: 2026-02-24
Auditor: GD
Method: Computed contrast ratios from shared/styles.css token values
Standard: WCAG 2.1 AA (normal text 4.5:1, large text/UI 3:1)

---

### Light Mode Token Values

- --bg-page: #F4F5F9
- --bg-input: #F8F9FC
- --text-primary: #1A1F36
- --text-secondary: #5E6378
- --color-correct: #1B7D3A
- --color-correct-bg: #F0FFF4
- --color-incorrect: #C8102E
- --color-incorrect-bg: #FFF5F5

### Light Mode Contrast Table

| Foreground | Background | Ratio | AA text | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| --text-primary #1A1F36 | --bg-page #F4F5F9 | 14.91:1 | PASS | Primary body text |
| --text-primary #1A1F36 | --bg-input #F8F9FC | 15.42:1 | PASS | Input text |
| --text-secondary #5E6378 | --bg-page #F4F5F9 | 5.46:1 | PASS | Secondary/muted labels |
| --text-secondary #5E6378 | --bg-input #F8F9FC | 5.65:1 | PASS | Hint text, captions |
| --color-correct #1B7D3A | --color-correct-bg #F0FFF4 | 5.03:1 | PASS | Correct feedback text |
| --color-incorrect #C8102E | --color-incorrect-bg #FFF5F5 | 5.50:1 | PASS | Incorrect feedback text |
| --color-incorrect #C8102E | --bg-page #F4F5F9 | 5.40:1 | PASS | Error msg on page |
| --color-correct #1B7D3A | --bg-page #F4F5F9 | 4.77:1 | PASS | Correct msg on page |

**Light mode: ALL PASS**

---

### Dark/Arena Mode Token Values

- --bg-page: #0A0E1A
- --bg-card: #141B2D
- --bg-input: #1A2240
- --text-primary: #E0E4EB
- --text-secondary: #8B92A8
- --color-correct: #2ECC71
- --color-correct-bg: #0D2818
- --color-incorrect: #FF3A55

### Dark Mode Contrast Table

| Foreground | Background | Ratio | AA text | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| --text-primary #E0E4EB | --bg-page #0A0E1A | 15.10:1 | PASS | Primary body text |
| --text-primary #E0E4EB | --bg-card #141B2D | 13.45:1 | PASS | Card text |
| --text-secondary #8B92A8 | --bg-page #0A0E1A | 6.21:1 | PASS | Secondary labels |
| --text-secondary #8B92A8 | --bg-card #141B2D | 5.53:1 | PASS | Muted card text |
| --color-correct #2ECC71 | --bg-card #141B2D | 8.16:1 | PASS | Correct feedback |
| --color-incorrect #FF3A55 | --bg-card #141B2D | 4.89:1 | PASS | Incorrect feedback |
| --color-correct #2ECC71 | --color-correct-bg #0D2818 | 7.49:1 | PASS | Correct state |

**Dark mode: ALL PASS**

---

### Summary

All exam.html color combinations pass WCAG 2.1 AA. No fixes required for shared/styles.css tokens.

### Outstanding Known Failure (still blocked: da-02)

- --fd-text-3 (#6E7681 or similar) on --fd-bg (#0d1117) in index.html autosave context
- Ratio: ~3.77:1 FAIL for normal text
- Fix already filed in Sprint 4. GA has not implemented. Needs re-ping.

### What This Audit Does NOT Cover

- Inline styles (a few buttons in exam.html use inline style attributes with --text-primary -- covered by token audit above)
- Dynamic content colors set via JavaScript (fb_correct, fb_wrong text from JSON -- these are --text-primary on --color-correct-bg, which passes above)
- Print mode (separate audit needed for print.css)

Audit complete. No action required from GA for this audit.
